summary: The Envoy listener now reports a forward that reached a registered, live role holder but got no acknowledgement within two seconds as receipt_timeout instead of delivery_failed; delivery_failed keeps every never-forwarded case and no_holder keeps no-claim. POST /v1/messages/publish accepts an optional dedupe_key used verbatim, mutually exclusive with idempotency_key (400 naming both, nothing published); /v1/messages/send is byte-for-byte unchanged. PR #1079 at fc7c2ab3ae2f4fe3fe04c16c5be826ca4612fe72.

pr.mergeable: MERGEABLE at open; no rebase needed
